reason: Per-site verified (RFC 0106 wave 4b): sqlite3/schema_statements.rb:9 is `PRAGMA index_list(#{quote_table_name(table_name)})`; trails splits an attached-schema-qualified name first and quotes the two halves with `quoteColumnName` (sqlite3/schema-statements.ts:109-116), because PRAGMA takes `schema.table` as two separately-quoted identifiers, not one quoted string.

Per-site verified (RFC 0106 wave 4b): sqlite3/schema_statements.rb:202 is `quote(name)`; trails' `quote` is a `this`-typed dispatch function needing the adapter as receiver, and `quotedScope` is a free function with no adapter in hand, so it applies the same `''`-doubling inline (sqlite3/schema-statements.ts:293).

Per-entry verified (RFC 0072 sqlite3 introspection cluster): Rails schema_statements.rb:88 ends the query_values probe with a block-less `.any?`; the port spells that emptiness test as `.length > 0` (JS arrays have no `any?`), same as the other `#any?` -> `.length > 0` entries in this baseline.
